newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor down on speculative offerings.
newsitem.headline: India castor down on speculative offerings.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery moved down by 2/3 rupees at 1,138/1,139 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative offerings on Wednesday, dealers said.
Sluggish overseas demand dragged local prices lower but some operators expected prices to bounce back in view of the sliding arrivals at producing centres.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped to 17,000/18,000 bags (75 kg each) from 22,000/23,000 bags recorded on Tuesday.
Groundnut oil drew consumer support to move up by 2/3 rupees at 363/364 rupees per 10 kg amid lower than expected summer crop arrivals.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by 10 rupees at 570 rupees per 15 kg amid unseasonal rain which had curtailed summer crop arrivals and affected crushing operations in the oil mills.
In Bombay imported palm-oil slid to 273 rupees per 10 kg from 275/276 rupees on fresh arrivals at the Bombay port as well as a fresh setback in the world market.
Traders estimated the stock of imported palm-oil in Bombay at 30,000/35,000 tonnes.
